trailhead.label: San Martino di Castrozza, the APT’s start

cautions: Village streets and road crossings in San Martino at the start and end.
Forest road shared with forestry vehicles.
An optional steeper path on the way up.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
